newsitem.title: USA: Royal Dutch down after going ex-dividend.
newsitem.headline: Royal Dutch down after going ex-dividend.

text.p: Shares of Royal Dutch Petroleum Co were down in active trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Tuesday after the company went ex-dividend, an industry analyst said.

The company paid out a dividend of 4.3 guilders, or about $2.50 on Monday, accounting for the corresponding drop of 2-1/8 to 155-3/8, said Waqar Syad, who covers Royal Dutch for Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
"When the announcement of the dividend was made, the stock went up. When it went ex-dividend it dropped by the amount of the dividend," Syad said.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
